text:
alina: Hey team — blocked on getting the staging subscription unblocked for our EUWest A100 rollout. Need a temporary vnet/ip burst + GPU quota increase for a customer demo on Tue. Opened a support case with Azure (2100123456) but asking for more info. Can someone help assemble the details?

matt: adding context: plan is to bring up 8x A100s in euwest4, short-lived (48h) burst to seed model cache. subnet currently only allows 16 IPs left.

janet: cc @ops-eng — finance approved short-lived burst cost, but we need the support case to include business justification and exact duration.

ops-eng: filing checklist: subscription id, vnet/subnet resource id, current NIC/ENI limit, desired GPU SKU + count, start/end time, business justification, contact + escalation email. Any missing?

alina: good list. subscription: 0a1b2c3d-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-0f9e8d7c6b5a. vnet: /subscriptions/0a1b2c3d/resourceGroups/rw-staging/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/stg-vnet. subnet: stg-ai-subnet. current subnet available IPs: 16. desired: +32 IPs for 72 hours. GPUs: 8 x Standard_ND96asr_v4 (A100 80GB) in euwest4.

matt: also call out NIC quota — we hit the 30 NIC / subscription default in this region recently. Need NIC quota to 64 for euwest4 to accommodate the nodes.

azure-support: Thanks for the details. Case 2100123456 has been updated. We need: 1) formal business justification (one paragraph), 2) exact UTC window for the burst, 3) whether this will be recurring, and 4) subscription owner email for escalation. We have assigned ESC-90876 for regional capacity team. ETA for initial response: 24-48 hours.

alina: business justification: "Redwood Inference staging demo for key prospect (FinServ) validating low-latency inference on A100s. Short burst to seed KV/cache and run end-to-end perf tests; missing capacity would delay contract decision. Requested duration 2026-04-01T08:00Z to 2026-04-04T08:00Z. Not recurring."

ops-eng: subscription owner: infra-admin@redwood.ai. I put that in the case.

janet: quick note on cost: estimated additional spend for 72h burst ~ $8k pre-discount. Confirmed in budget.

matt: workaround thought: if Azure can't approve in time, can we fall back to euwest2 with smaller SKUs temporarily? That'll change perf but might allow demo. Would need config change to model cache pre-warm scripts.

alina: preference is to keep euwest4 to match customer region (data residency + perf). fallback only if ESC denies.

sre-bot: ALERT: cluster-autoscaler failed 3 times in the last hour in cluster stg-euwest4 — scheduling blocked due to insufficient instance quota (A100). Pod: rw-inference-prewarm-1. See logs: ```E0900 12:03:12 scheduler.go:345 insufficient quota for node group gpu-a100-80gb```

azure-support: Update on ESC-90876: regional capacity team acknowledged the request. They require confirmation that nodes will be deleted at burst end and that we will not exceed quotas after endtime. Also requested target scale set name and expected node naming pattern. We can provision a short-term capacity reservation once the business justification is accepted.

alina: node group name: rw-stg-a100-pool. Nodes will be deleted at endtime, autoscaler will scale down to 0 GPUs. Will not be recurring. Added assert in deploy playbook to tear down.

azure-support: Thanks — we've marked the case for expedited review. Current ETA: 18-36 hours for approval, but escalation team may approve sooner if you provide the following command output in the case: ```az network vnet subnet show --ids /subscriptions/0a1b2c3d/resourceGroups/rw-staging/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/stg-vnet/subnets/stg-ai-subnet --query "ipConfigurations[*].privateIPAddress"``` and quota proofs for NICs and GPU.

ops-eng: pasted az output into case and attached screenshot of quota dashboard.

matt: pinging cloud TAM to see if we can get a phone triage. @azure-support can you escalate to TAM with contact cc infra-admin@redwood.ai?

azure-support: We have escalated to TAM and notified the capacity ops on-call. They've added a note: "phone triage available within 2 hours if needed" and requested a contact number.

alina: contact number +1-415-555-0132. Added to case.

sre-bot: FYI: I've queued a prewarm job to reduce start-up wall time once nodes come up — it will retry every 5 mins until capacity available.

janet: please keep finance looped if approval goes beyond estimate.

alina: will update case and share link when capacity confirmed. thanks all. :thumbsup:

azure-support: Case 2100123456 updated: ESC-90876 -> assigned to CapacityOps-EU. Current status: Pending validation. Next update expected within 24 hours. If you need phone triage now, reply with "PRIORITY CALL" in the case.

matt: noted. i'll hold off on the fallback until 12h before window.

alina: acknowledged. I'll post here once we have green light.
